Package net.ygbstudio.powerwp4j.builders

Class WPMediaPayloadBuilder

java.lang.Object
net.ygbstudio.powerwp4j.base.extension.builders.AbstractMediaPayloadBuilder<WPMediaPayloadBuilder>
net.ygbstudio.powerwp4j.builders.WPMediaPayloadBuilder
public class WPMediaPayloadBuilder extends AbstractMediaPayloadBuilder<WPMediaPayloadBuilder>
Builder for WordPress media attachment payloads. Inherits all methods from its abstract superclass to provide a chainable pattern for building media attachment payloads.

If you need to use a builder for posts or taxonomies, use WPBasicPayloadBuilder.
